# dokku_ports (Data Source)

Manages the ports for a given dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_ports" "example" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `port_mappings` (Attributes Set) Port mappings to set; under state 'present' and 'set' no two may share a scheme and host port. Each item has: scheme, host, container. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--port_mappings))

<a id="nestedatt--port_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `port_mappings`

Read-Only:

- `container` (Number) Container of the port mapping
- `host` (Number) Host of the port mapping
- `scheme` (String) Scheme of the port mapping
